description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, a simple Android activity that displays program information such as title, description, and genres. It includes constants for intent extras and a companion object with a helper method to create intent objects for launching this activity.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays program details such as title, description, and genres, retrieved from intent extras and shown in TextViews. Provides a static method to create properly configured intents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, retrieves intent extras, and updates TextViews to display program information.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Static helper method to create an intent for launching ContentInfoActivity with program details passed as extras.
